name: GTA VI Cheats: What Is Verified
summary: A safe reference for locating the cheat system and understanding its save and trophy consequences.
description: Cheat codes are available in GTA VI, but code lists can vary by patch and published walkthrough. This guide deliberately links to a maintained code index instead of repeating unverified phone numbers or button sequences. Read the warning on the individual code before activating it: cheats can disable trophies/achievements for the current session, and some guides advise not saving a cheated session.

steps.title: Make a clean manual save
steps.content: Create a separate manual save before experimenting with cheats. Keep your completion run on an untouched save.
steps.tip: A new save slot makes it easier to return to a clean run.

steps.title: Open the in-game phone
steps.content: Use Up on the D-pad to open the phone, then choose the dialer if the selected code uses a phone number. Some codes use controller inputs instead.
steps.tip: Follow the entry method shown beside each code in the linked code index.

steps.title: Check the code against a current list
steps.content: Use the linked launch-era cheat index for exact inputs, unlock conditions, and known effects. Do not rely on guessed vehicle names or code sequences.
steps.tip: Recheck after updates; code availability can change with patches and story progress.

steps.title: Return to the clean save
steps.content: If you care about trophies, achievements, or a clean completion record, reload the manual save made before activating cheats.
steps.tip: Treat any trophy warning displayed by the game as authoritative.

requirements: A manual save slot reserved for experiments.
Check the current source list for the exact code and its effect before entering it.
commonMistakes: Using a code on your main completion save.
Assuming every cheat is a phone code or that an old list still matches the current patch.
